notes.title: A Storm is Coming...
notes.content:
[p]Every time I sit down to write an update I conclude that the time spent on it would be better used working on the game itself.

But I do realize that people need to know what's happening with the game. So here it is! 

In short: I am still alive, and the game is progressing really well, check out the screenshots and videos below!:D[/p][p]
[/p][h1]The Playtest[/h1][p]The most important news is that there was a closed playtest a couple of months ago!

Around 1,500 people requested access.[/p][p]Exactly 600 people got access to the first version of the demo. [/p][p]Around 300 people played it.[/p][p]And around 50-100 people provided feedback.[/p][p]
Currently there are another 5,000 people in queue, I'm sorry but you will have to wait for the next iteration, I promise it will be better and worth the wait!:P

[/p][h1]The Feedback[/h1][list][*][p]The current version of the game is simply not scary enough[/p][/*][*][p]There is too much empty space (map is too big, walking simulator vibes)[/p][/*][*][p]Nobody noticed the monster, he was too subtle haha[/p][/*][*][p]The story was too complicated and confusing[/p][/*][*][p]The intro sequence was quite boring and prolonged[/p][/*][*][p]The new dialogue system requires actual voice overs to be recorded, which is quite expensive and complicates a lot of stuff[/p][/*][*][p]The physics interactions aren't intuitive - I tried to improve them from Clap Clap, but they are still too difficult to use[/p][/*][*][p]I was overly ambitious in so many aspects - tons of effects, characters, massive maps, I also planned 3 chapters in the full game etc...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]It might look like a ton of bad news. But it's actually not!:D I learned [b]A TON[/b] working on this iteration of the game. The feedback I got is [b]pure gold[/b].  The next iteration of the game is going to be sooo much better.

[/p][h1]The New Version[/h1][p]I had two options:[/p][list][*][p]try to address the feedback and release a mediocre game[/p][/*][*][p]or scrap [b]a ton[/b] of stuff and do a major pivot[/p][/*][/list][p]I decided to scrap a massive amount of work. It was risky. It was stressful. But I truly want to provide the best possible experience that I can muster. Here's some of the things that are changing...[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Story Overhaul[/h2][p]I've decided to simplify the story massively. At the moment the synopsis looks like this (W.I.P.):[/p][p][/p][p][i]"When an ambitious archaeologist discovers a map to a forgotten island, you — the ship’s mechanic — are dragged into a voyage into the unknown."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I believe that now it's super clear about [b]who you are[/b], [b]what you do[/b], [b]why you are there[/b] and [b]where you are going[/b]. [/p][p]Everything is communicated in a single sentence.

[/p][h2]Visual Overhaul[/h2][p][b](I apologize for the poor video quality; the videos are heavily compressed because I post them on my discord community)
[/b][/p][p]In the previous iteration I was using a ton of custom made assets, but also assets that I bought and modified to speed up development.
[/p][p]This ended up creating a ton of optimization issues and also the visuals didn't look like they came from a singular mind no matter how much I tried to modify stuff. Just too many issues.
[/p][p]So, I decided to go all in and make everything myself. Here's a few quick screenshots/videos!

[/p][h3]The Island[/h3][p]I got heavily inspired by the old King Kong The official game of the movie, or whatever its name is haha So I decided to completely overhaul my colorful island to a darker one. Here's the new look:[/p][previewyoutube="qlEZE01VdgA;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]

The Ship[/h3][p]Here is a quick screenshot of some of the new models that will be used to recreate the ship level. The textures are a lot more detailed this time around and everything is just so much more cohesive.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204671/3daa2293abed0b7c5799d25635b5e3df9e648e10.png"][/img]
The Labyrinth[/h3][p]This went through quite a few iterations - from a cave tunnel system to what it is now. I really like how it turned out. Cob webs, cockroaches, moths, ice cold walls, the only bit of warmth comes from your torch.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204671/16f669bcf5faced4442485a100199f3b266d3931.png"][/img]
Monster AI Overhaul[/h2][p]In the previous iteration I was relying a lot on scripted events for scary/spooky moments. [/p][p]Moving forward, there will still be some scripted events, but the bulk of the horror will be unpredictable due to the new monster AI who has a mind of his own and does what he wants to do.
[/p][p]Here's a sneak peek:[/p][previewyoutube="RjUpe7pJ1qU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Nothing in the video is scripted and the frantic camera movement came from my genuine fear:D

[/p][h2]Puzzles[/h2][p]I've also started designing some puzzles. The goal will be to have relatively simple, yet interesting and tactile puzzles that provide a breather between the intense sections of the game.
[/p][p]Here's an early look into the gear system I've been working on:[/p][previewyoutube="oqdUVeBb61U;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="mhtUWzl2dnE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
There's actually a ton more to show, but I'd rather spend that time working on the game!:P 
I'll try to write up more updates soon, but no promises this time!

Thank you for being here! <3[/p]

notes.title: Something stirs on this island...
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just a quick update to show what I’ve been working on.

I realized that I should post something here from time to time, so people know that the game is actively being worked on!:) I have to be careful though, as not to spoil anything:)

Not much to say—just some sights from the world. Make of them what you will;)

[h3] 🏔️ An ominous mountain [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204671/1755b63336d29cb4651597903549f98d0b88dcd1.png[/img]

[h3] 🔥 The fire crackles, but no one is here [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204671/1b6c9c801f5294aebeb8043e1ebded3554d072ea.png[/img]

[h3] 🚪 What's behind this door? [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204671/1e776fd62a4dcd428db7bfb653a58d6aea597d05.png[/img]

As you can see, there are still some cubes here and there that I have to replace. But the game is slowly taking shape!:D
